dialogues.speaker: Pahua
dialogues.text: Let me think... Hmm, now that I think about it, when the volcano erupted before, it ejected a bunch of Condessence Crystals from deep within the earth.

dialogues.speaker: Pahua
dialogues.text: I'll mark the location on your map and you can check it out if you're interested. As far as you're concerned, I imagine digging up minerals counts as a productive training session.
